integration_decision.name: NONVACUOUS_TWO_BOUNDARY_PUBLICATION_BARRIER_HANDOFF
integration_decision.new_substantive_detail: Source-pinned exact order: runner.run_once loads archive once, then independently publishes latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json; archive lock is released before publishing. Existing two-child test joins A before B starts, so it cannot witness a stale publication. Convert the existing frozen two-boundary contract into explicit deterministic barrier phases and isolated A/B golden fingerprints; do not edit source or queue a task.
runnable_no_network_contract: Pin exact SHA db4c6bf1; use only temporary local_dir and as_of_ms fixed T, network=False; no credentials, sleeps as oracle, mocks of handoff, skips, or production changes.

Build isolated A-only (empty archive) and B-only (one PIT-visible rowB) golden outputs for latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json; capture canonical parsed JSON and per-path SHA-256, plus returned/persisted source_evidence effective source_record_id/role.

Spawn child A on empty shared archive. A child installs test-only wrapper around runner.atomic_write_json to signal an event and wait at (1) immediately AFTER A latest.json publication and separately (2) immediately BEFORE A anata_latest.json publication; prove A had loaded 0 rows before release.

While A is blocked, parent append rowB to observations.jsonl using real append_observations, then spawn B on same directory. Require B exitcode 0, loaded/scoring 1/1, returned rowB scoring identity, and positively witnessed B publication of ALL THREE JSON files with B golden fingerprints BEFORE releasing A.

Release A, join with bounded timeouts, read all final JSON files and compare per-path parsed values/hashes to B-only golden outputs. Any A-old artifact or cross-generation mix is a witnessed RED; missing B-before-A-release publication witness is INCONCLUSIVE, not PASS.

Run recovery C after failure/interleave and verify three final artifacts equal C/B-current golden, no stale resurrection; independently assert both scoring/context source_record_id→role for returned and persisted handoff with score_rec_1445_01 and context_rec_1445_01.

Record collect-only, focused tests and full python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests transcripts, exact SHA, child exitcodes, barrier events, artifact hashes, errors, and pytest exit codes; require independent Planner C review.
integration_decision.claim_boundary: This is an unexecuted handoff contract, not a reproduced production race or a PASS. Existing frozen regression intent preserved; no new speculative Gemini task.
